prompt: Write a repository-style lookup that returns Optional instead of null: find members by id and by email, and turn a missing member into a default name.
explanation: Returning Optional makes the "not found" case part of the method signature, so callers cannot forget it the way they forget a null check. Optional.of wraps a value that is definitely there and Optional.empty() stands for the miss; the finder returns as soon as it has a hit. nameOf then composes rather than branches: map applies Member::name only when a member was found, and orElse supplies the default otherwise.
hints: A plain for loop over members with an early `return Optional.of(member);` is fine -- end the method with `return Optional.empty();`.
Guard the null email before calling trim, then compare with equalsIgnoreCase so capitalisation does not matter.
